caption: The free SEO Checker gave our first site 80% with 2 critical issues and a 0.28 second load time. Without an account you get 3 checks a day, shared across the tools.
It says No additional page markup was found, while the page has 3 JSON-LD blocks. It also counts decorative favicons with an empty alt text as images without alt.
For our second site it flags the title at 671 pixels against a 580 pixel limit, and passes the meta description at 849 of 1,000 pixels.
After the third check of the day the Ranking Checker locks: 0 of 3 checks left. It still shows search volume 90, 9% competition and a $1.29 CPC for ai tool reviews. Our domain is hidden.
Monthly prices in euros, plus VAT: Premium 59.90, Professional 99.90 and Agency 209.90 a month after a 14 day free trial. The contract renews every month and you can cancel any time.
Paying yearly saves 20%: Premium 575.04, Professional 959.04 and Agency 2,015.04 euros a year. We did not start a trial or reach a checkout.
